instruction: A candid studio photograph captured in a medium close-up from a high angle. Against a plain white background, the woman with straight brown hair (R1) sits on the left, leaning her head on the shoulder of the woman with curly dark hair (R2) who sits on the right. R1 has her eyes closed, resting her hand on R2's shoulder. R2 sits upright, looking off to the right side with a calm, serene expression. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates the scene, creating a gentle, intimate mood with a neutral color palette.
